concerns.text: The plan validates the edge‑spectrum shift by computing Pearson‑r between the shift vector (derived from mean embeddings of only two non‑English languages vs. English) and WALS typological differences, and similarly correlates shift magnitude with SentEval STS degradation. With only three languages (English, French, Chinese) this yields at most two data points for each correlation, which is statistically insufficient for any meaningful Pearson correlation. The validation target is therefore not independent enough and the analysis cannot reliably support the claimed relationship.
